title: Armor Durability Warning
description:
Warns you by ringing bells and chat messages when your armor pieces go below a adjustable threshold.

GUI Key - O
body:
# Armor HUD Mod

# Overview

Armor HUD is a Minecraft Fabric mod that provides a simple and effective way to monitor your equipped armor durability without opening the inventory. It displays important armor information directly on the screen, allowing players to quickly check the condition of their gear while playing.

# Features
Displays durability information for equipped armor pieces.
Provides a customizable HUD for better visibility.
Allows players to set durability warning thresholds.
Sends notifications when armor durability becomes low.
Works smoothly without affecting normal gameplay.

# Advantages

Better Awareness: Players can always see their armor condition during gameplay.
Prevents Unexpected Breaks: Alerts help avoid losing protection because of broken armor.
Saves Time: Removes the need to repeatedly open the inventory to check durability.
Useful in Combat: Helps players prepare repairs or replacements during PvP and dangerous situations.

**Customizable Experience: Players can adjust settings based on their preferences.**

# Use Cases

Armor HUD is useful for survival players, PvP players, explorers, and builders who depend on their equipment. It helps manage resources efficiently during long adventures, mining sessions, and battles.

# Performance

The mod is lightweight and designed to run efficiently with Fabric. It does not modify Minecraft's core mechanics and focuses only on improving the player's information display.

# Conclusion

Armor HUD improves the Minecraft experience by making armor durability tracking easier, faster, and more convenient. It provides essential information at a glance while keeping gameplay simple and immersive.
